name: Bandit
description: Bandits rove in gangs and are sometimes led by thugs, veterans, or spellcasters. Not all bandits are evil—poverty, desperation, or circumstance drives many to criminality.

statBlock.actions: Scimitar: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 slashing. Light Crossbow: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d8+1 piercing.

name: Bandit Captain
description: It takes a strong personality, ruthless cunning, and a silver tongue to keep a gang of bandits in line. The bandit captain has these in spades.

statBlock.traits: Multiattack: 3 attacks; 2 with scimitar and 1 with dagger.
statBlock.actions: Scimitar: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing. Dagger (melee): +5 to hit, 1d4+3 piercing. Dagger (ranged): +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., 1d4+3 piercing. Parry (reaction): +2 to AC against one melee attack.

name: Berserker
description: Hailing from uncivilized lands, berserkers are warriors who channel their rage into vicious fighting styles.

statBlock.traits: Reckless: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
statBlock.actions: Greataxe: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d12+3 slashing.

name: Commoner
description: Commoners include peasants, serfs, slaves, servants, pilgrims, merchants, artisans, and hermits.

statBlock.actions: Club: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4 bludgeoning.

name: Cult Fanatic
description: Fanatics are often part of a cult's leadership, enjoying a higher status than regular cultists. They wield divine magic in service to their deity or patron.

statBlock.traits: Dark Devotion: The fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Spellcasting (Wis, save DC 11): 1st (4 slots): command, inflict wounds, shield of faith; 2nd (2 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon.
statBlock.actions: Multiattack: 2 attacks. Dagger: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing.

name: Cultist
description: Cultists swear allegiance to dark powers such as elemental princes, demon lords, or archdevils.

statBlock.traits: Dark Devotion: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
statBlock.actions: Scimitar: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 slashing.

name: Guard
description: Guards include members of a city watch, sentinels in a citadel or fortified town, and the bodyguards of merchants and nobles.

statBlock.actions: Spear: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d6+1 or 1d8+1 piercing.

name: Knight
description: Knights are warriors who pledge service to rulers, religious orders, and noble causes.

statBlock.traits: Brave: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Greatsword: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 slashing. Heavy Crossbow: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., 1d10 piercing. Leadership (recharge 5–6): For 1 minute, allies within 30 ft. can add 1d4 to attack rolls or saving throws. Parry (reaction): +2 to AC against one melee attack.

name: Mage
description: Mages spend their lives in the study of magic, learning ever more potent spells to serve their ambitions.

statBlock.traits: Spellcasting (Int, save DC 14, +6 to hit): Cantrips: fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation; 1st (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield; 2nd (3 slots): misty step, suggestion; 3rd (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly; 4th (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm; 5th (1 slot): cone of cold.
statBlock.actions: Dagger: +5 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing.

name: Priest
description: Priests bring the teachings of their gods to the common folk. They are called to their gods through signs and miracles.

statBlock.traits: Divine Eminence: As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to deal +10d6 radiant on a hit. Spellcasting (Wis, save DC 13): Cantrips: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy; 1st (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary; 2nd (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon; 3rd (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians.
statBlock.actions: Mace: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6 bludgeoning.

name: Scout
description: Scouts are skilled hunters and trackers who offer their services for a fee.

statBlock.traits: Keen Hearing and Sight: Advantage on Perception checks relying on hearing or sight. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Shortsword: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing. Longbow: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.

name: Spy
description: Rulers, nobles, merchants, guildmasters, and other wealthy individuals use spies to gain the upper hand in a world of cutthroat politics.

statBlock.skills: Deception +5, Insight +4, Investigation +5, Perception +6, Persuasion +5, Sleight of Hand +4, Stealth +4
statBlock.traits: Cunning Action: Can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action. Sneak Attack (1/turn): +2d6 damage with advantage or when ally is adjacent to target. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Shortsword: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing. Hand Crossbow: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.

name: Thug
description: Thugs are ruthless enforcers skilled at intimidation and violence. They work for money and have little interest in ethics.

statBlock.traits: Pack Tactics: Advantage on attack rolls when an ally is adjacent to target. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Mace: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+2 bludgeoning. Heavy Crossbow: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., 1d10 piercing.

name: Veteran
description: Veterans are professional fighters that take up arms for pay or to protect something they believe in or value.

statBlock.traits: Multiattack: 2 longsword attacks; if available, 1 shortsword attack.
statBlock.actions: Longsword: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 or 1d10+3 slashing. Shortsword: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 piercing. Heavy Crossbow: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., 1d10+1 piercing.

name: Goblin
description: Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in caves, abandoned mines, and dismal settings.

statBlock.traits: Nimble Escape: Can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action each turn.
statBlock.actions: Scimitar: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing. Shortbow: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.

name: Hobgoblin
description: War is the lifeblood of hobgoblins. Militaristic to the core, hobgoblins live for battle.

statBlock.traits: Martial Advantage (1/turn): +2d6 damage when an ally is adjacent to the target.
statBlock.actions: Longsword: +3 to hit, 1d8+1 or 1d10+1 slashing. Longbow: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+1 piercing.

name: Bugbear
description: Bugbears are hulking, hairy goblinoids who live for the thrill of the hunt and the rush of sudden attacks.

statBlock.traits: Brute: Deals +1 die on melee attacks (included). Surprise Attack: +2d6 damage on first hit against a creature that hasn't acted yet.
statBlock.actions: Morningstar: +4 to hit, 2d8+2 piercing. Javelin: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., 2d6+2 piercing.

name: Orc
description: Orcs are savage raiders and pillagers with stooped postures, low foreheads, and piggish faces with prominent lower canines.

statBlock.traits: Aggressive: As a bonus action, can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature.
statBlock.actions: Greataxe: +5 to hit, 1d12+3 slashing. Javelin: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.

name: Kobold
description: Kobolds are craven reptilian humanoids that worship evil dragons as demigods.

statBlock.traits: Pack Tactics: Advantage on attacks when an ally is adjacent to target. Sunlight Sensitivity: Disadvantage on attacks and Perception in sunlight.
statBlock.actions: Dagger: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing. Sling: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., 1d4+2 bludgeoning.

name: Gnoll
description: Gnolls are hyena-headed humanoids that rampage across the land, driven by insatiable hunger.

statBlock.traits: Rampage: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 HP, it can move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing. Spear: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d6+2 or 1d8+2 piercing. Longbow: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+1 piercing.

name: Troll
description: Trolls are ravenous, hunched giants whose voracious appetite is matched only by their extraordinary ability to regenerate.

statBlock.traits: Keen Smell: Advantage on Perception checks using smell. Regeneration: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. Fire and acid damage prevents regeneration this turn. The troll dies only if at 0 HP and can't regenerate. Multiattack: 1 bite, 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 1d6+4 piercing. Claw: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing.

name: Ogre
description: Ogres are hulking, simple-minded creatures that live to feed and breed.

statBlock.actions: Greatclub: +6 to hit, 2d8+4 bludgeoning. Javelin: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., 2d6+4 piercing.

name: Hill Giant
description: Hill giants are selfish, dim-witted giants that raid farmsteads and villages for food.

statBlock.traits: Multiattack: 2 greatclub attacks.
statBlock.actions: Greatclub: +8 to hit, 3d8+5 bludgeoning. Rock: +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., 3d10+5 bludgeoning.

name: Frost Giant
description: Frost giants are brutal, primitive raiders who live for conquest and plunder.

statBlock.traits: Cold Immunity. Multiattack: 2 greataxe attacks.
statBlock.actions: Greataxe: +9 to hit, 3d12+6 slashing. Rock: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., 4d10+6 bludgeoning.

name: Fire Giant
description: Fire giants are militaristic tyrants that dwell among volcanoes and in deep, fiery dungeons.

statBlock.traits: Fire Immunity. Multiattack: 2 greatsword attacks.
statBlock.actions: Greatsword: +10 to hit, 6d6+7 slashing. Rock: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., 4d10+7 bludgeoning.

name: Skeleton
description: Skeletons arise when animated by dark magic. They most commonly serve as guards or soldiers in service to their creator.

statBlock.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
statBlock.traits: Vulnerabilities: bludgeoning. Immunities: poison, exhaustion; poisoned condition.
statBlock.actions: Shortsword: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing. Shortbow: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.

name: Zombie
description: Zombies are animated corpses driven by the magic of necromancers. They follow simple orders and attack living creatures.

statBlock.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
statBlock.traits: Undead Fortitude: If damage reduces zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Con saving throw DC 5 + damage taken. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP. Immunities: poison; poisoned condition.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 bludgeoning.

name: Ghoul
description: Ghouls are undead that roam in packs, hungrily seeking the dead to devour.

statBlock.traits: Immunities: poison, charmed, exhaustion; poisoned, unconscious conditions.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +2 to hit, 2d6+2 piercing. Claws: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 slashing. On claw hit, target makes DC 10 Con save or is paralyzed until end of its next turn (elves immune).

name: Wight
description: A wight is a spirit of evil given undead form by dark magic or the will of a demon lord.

statBlock.languages: the languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Sunlight Sensitivity. Resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered. Immunities: poison; exhaustion, poisoned. Multiattack: 1 life drain + 1 longsword, or 2 longbow.
statBlock.actions: Life Drain: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 necrotic. Max HP reduced by damage dealt. Longsword: +4 to hit, 1d8+2 or 1d10+2 slashing. Longbow: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.

name: Wraith
description: A wraith is the undead spirit of a hateful or evil humanoid who died violently.

statBlock.languages: the languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Incorporeal Movement: Can move through objects; takes 1d10 force if ends in object. Sunlight Sensitivity. Resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
statBlock.actions: Life Drain: +6 to hit, 4d8+3 necrotic, max HP reduced. Create Specter: Humanoid killed can become a specter under wraith's control.

name: Vampire Spawn
description: Vampire spawn are undead creatures that subsist on the blood of the living. They serve their vampire masters with fearful devotion.

statBlock.languages: the languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Regeneration: Regains 10 HP/turn; not in sunlight or running water. Spider Climb. Vampire Weaknesses: sunlight, holy water, stake through heart, etc. Resistances: necrotic, nonmagical B/P/S. Multiattack: 2 attacks; only 1 can be a bite.
statBlock.actions: Claws: +6 to hit, 2d4+3 slashing, grapple on hit. Bite: +6 to hit, grappled/incapacitated target only, 1d6+3 piercing + 2d6 necrotic; max HP reduced; regains HP equal to necrotic damage.

name: Vampire
description: Vampires are undead beings of tremendous evil power who feast on the blood of the living.

statBlock.languages: the languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Shapechanger: Bat or mist form. Legendary Actions (3/round). Regeneration: 20 HP/turn unless sunlight/running water. Spider Climb. Resistances/Immunities. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Unarmed: +9 to hit, 1d8+4 bludgeoning + grapple. Bite: +9 to hit, grappled target, 1d6+4 + 3d6 necrotic; target's max HP reduced. Charm: DC 17 Wis save or charmed for 24 hours. Children of the Night: Summons swarms of bats/rats or wolves.

name: Lich
description: A lich is a spellcaster who has willingly undergone a terrible ritual to become an undead creature of immense power.

statBlock.languages: Common plus up to five other languages
statBlock.traits: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). Rejuvenation: Returns after 1d10 days if phylactery intact. Spellcasting (Int, save DC 20, +12 to hit): Cantrips: mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost; plus many high-level spells through 9th level. Turn Resistance: Advantage on saves against turn undead. Immunities: cold, electricity, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned. Legendary Actions (3/round).
statBlock.actions: Paralyzing Touch: +12 to hit, 3d6 cold, DC 18 Con or paralyzed for 1 minute.

name: Ghost
description: Ghosts are undead spirits of the dead that linger in the world due to unfinished business.

statBlock.languages: any languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Ethereal Sight: Can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane. Incorporeal Movement. Resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
statBlock.actions: Withering Touch: +5 to hit, 4d6+3 necrotic. Etherealness: Enter or exit Ethereal Plane. Horrifying Visage: Creatures within 60 ft., DC 13 Wis or frightened for 1 minute. Possession (recharge 6): Humanoid within 5 ft. makes DC 13 Cha save or possessed.

name: Shadow
description: A shadow is undead darkness that drains strength from the living. A humanoid slain by it rises as a shadow.

statBlock.traits: Amorphous. Shadow Stealth: Hide as bonus action in dim light or darkness. Sunlight Weakness. Vulnerabilities: radiant. Immunities: cold, necrotic, poison; exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained. Resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; nonmagical B/P/S.
statBlock.actions: Strength Drain: +4 to hit, 2d6+2 necrotic; target's STR reduced by 1d4. If STR reaches 0, target dies and rises as a shadow.

name: Mummy
description: Mummies are ancient corpses preserved through embalming and dark magic, awakened to wreak vengeance on tomb robbers.

statBlock.languages: the languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Vulnerabilities: fire. Resistances: nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned. Multiattack: 1 rotting fist + 1 dreadful glare.
statBlock.actions: Rotting Fist: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 bludgeoning + 3d6 necrotic; cursed on hit, disadvantage on saves. Dreadful Glare: DC 11 Wis save or frightened until end of next turn.

name: Imp
description: Imps are the least of all devils, sent to the mortal realm to corrupt mortals and serve as scouts or spies.

statBlock.traits: Shapechanger: Rat, raven, or spider form. Devil's Sight: Magical darkness. Magic Resistance. Resistances: cold, nonmagical B/P/S from non-silvered. Immunities: fire, poison; poisoned.
statBlock.actions: Sting (true form): +5 to hit, 1d4+3 piercing + 3d4 poison. Invisibility.

name: Incubus / Succubus
description: Succubi and incubi are fiends that feed on the desires of mortals. They assume humanoid guise to seduce and drain their victims.

statBlock.traits: Telepathic Bond. Shapechanger. Magic Resistance. Resistances: cold, fire, lightning, poison; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: poison; poisoned.
statBlock.actions: Claw (fiend form): +5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing + 2d6 psychic. Charm: DC 15 Wis save or charmed for 1 day, takes 5d10 psychic on a failed save. Draining Kiss: sleeping/willing target, 5d12 psychic, max HP reduced. Etherealness.

name: Pit Fiend
description: Pit fiends are the most powerful devils that serve as generals and commanders in the Nine Hells.

statBlock.traits: Aura of Fear: 20-ft. radius, DC 21 Wis or frightened on start of turn. Legendary Resistance (3/day). Magic Resistance. Spellcasting (Cha, save DC 21): detect magic, fireball, hold monster, wall of fire. Immunities: fire, poison; poisoned. Resistances: cold, nonmagical B/P/S. Multiattack: 4 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +14 to hit, 4d6+8 piercing + 3d6 poison + DC 21 Con or poisoned for 1 minute. Claw: +14 to hit, 2d8+8 slashing. Mace: +14 to hit, 2d6+8 + 2d6 fire. Tail: +14 to hit, 2d8+8 bludgeoning.

name: Balor
description: Balors are terrifying demon lords who rule layers of the Abyss with flame and whip.

statBlock.traits: Death Throes: Explodes on death, 20-ft. radius, DC 20 Dex or 70 fire. Legendary Resistance (3/day). Magic Resistance. Fire Aura: 5 ft., 3d6 fire. Immunities: fire, poison; poisoned. Resistances: cold, lightning; nonmagical B/P/S. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Longsword: +14 to hit, 3d8+8 slashing + 4d6 lightning. Whip: +14 to hit, 2d6+8 slashing; on hit target makes DC 20 Str save or pulled adjacent and restrained.

name: Vrock
description: Vrocks are vulture-headed demons that screech horribly and shower foes with spores from their filthy feathers.

statBlock.traits: Magic Resistance. Resistances: cold, fire, lightning; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: poison; poisoned. Multiattack: 1 beak + 2 talons.
statBlock.actions: Beak: +6 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing. Talon: +6 to hit, 2d10+3 slashing. Spores (recharge 6): 15-ft. radius, DC 14 Con or 5d8 poison; spores burst 1d4 rounds later for additional damage. Stunning Screech (1/day): creatures within 20 ft., DC 14 Con or stunned.

name: Beholder
description: A beholder is a floating mass of madness with a central eye and ten eyestalks, each capable of terrible magical attacks.

statBlock.traits: Antimagic Cone: 150-ft. cone in front; magic suppressed inside. Legendary Resistance (3/day). Legendary Actions (3/round). Immunities: prone.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 4d6 piercing. Eye Rays (3/round): 10 random rays, range 120 ft.; includes charm, paralyzing, fear, slowing, enervating, telekinetic, sleep, petrification, disintegration, death rays.

name: Mind Flayer
description: Mind flayers are evil aberrations that eat brains and use their psionic powers to dominate others.

statBlock.skills: Arcana +7, Deception +6, Insight +6, Perception +6, Persuasion +6, Stealth +4
statBlock.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., truesight 5 ft., passive Perception 16
statBlock.traits: Magic Resistance. Spellcasting (Int, save DC 15): detect thoughts, levitate; dominate monster (1/day), plane shift (1/day).
statBlock.actions: Tentacles: +7 to hit, 2d10+4 psychic; DC 15 Int or stunned. Extract Brain: stunned target, +7 to hit, 10d10 piercing, instant kill on 0 HP. Mind Blast (recharge 5–6): 60-ft. cone, DC 15 Int or 4d8+4 psychic and stunned.

name: Owlbear
description: An owlbear is a ferocious beast that resembles a bear with the head of an owl. These creatures are aggressive hunters.

statBlock.traits: Keen Sight and Smell: Advantage on Perception relying on sight or smell. Multiattack: 1 beak + 1 claws.
statBlock.actions: Beak: +7 to hit, 1d10+5 piercing. Claws: +7 to hit, 2d8+5 slashing.

name: Basilisk
description: A basilisk is a fearsome reptile that turns living creatures to stone with its terrible gaze.

statBlock.traits: Petrifying Gaze: At start of turn, if creature within 30 ft. can see the basilisk's eyes, DC 12 Con save or restrained; another save next turn or petrified.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing + 2d6 poison.

name: Mimic
description: A mimic is a shapeshifting creature that can take the form of inanimate objects to lure in prey.

statBlock.traits: Shapechanger: Assume object form. Adhesive (object form): Grapple on hit; DC 13 Str to escape. False Appearance: Indistinguishable from object when motionless. Grappler: Advantage on attack rolls against creatures it has grappled. Immunities: acid, prone.
statBlock.actions: Pseudopod: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 bludgeoning. Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing + 1d8 acid.

name: Minotaur
description: Minotaurs are savage creatures that roam labyrinths and wild places, goring and trampling everything in their path.

statBlock.traits: Charge: If moves 10 ft. toward target and hits with gore, +2d8 piercing damage and DC 14 Str save or knocked prone. Labyrinthine Recall: Perfect memory for any path traveled. Reckless: See Berserker trait. Multiattack: 1 gore + 1 greataxe.
statBlock.actions: Greataxe: +6 to hit, 2d12+4 slashing. Gore: +6 to hit, 2d8+4 piercing.

name: Harpy
description: Harpies are winged creatures with female humanoid torsos who lure prey with enchanting song.

statBlock.traits: Multiattack: 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Claws: +3 to hit, 2d4+1 slashing. Luring Song: All creatures within 300 ft. that hear the song, DC 11 Wis save or charmed and incapacitated, movement toward harpy on their turn.

name: Gargoyle
description: Gargoyles are magical statues that perch on buildings and guard treasures with stone-cold menace.

statBlock.traits: False Appearance: Indistinguishable from a statue when motionless. Resistances: B/P/S from nonmagical non-adamantine. Immunities: poison, psychic; exhaustion, petrified, poisoned. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Claws: +4 to hit, 2d6+2 slashing. Bite: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing.

name: Worg
description: Worgs are evil, intelligent predators that delight in hunting and killing. They are often ridden by goblins.

statBlock.traits: Keen Hearing and Smell: Advantage on Perception using hearing or smell.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing; DC 13 Str save or knocked prone.

name: Phase Spider
description: A phase spider can shift between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane, making it a terrifying ambush predator.

statBlock.traits: Ethereal Jaunt: Bonus action to shift between Material and Ethereal Plane. Spider Climb. Web Walker.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d10+2 piercing + 4d8 poison (DC 11 Con for half).

name: Rust Monster
description: A rust monster can corrode and destroy metal equipment with its feathered antennae.

statBlock.traits: Iron Scent: Can pinpoint metal within 30 ft. Rust Metal: Metal weapons used against it permanently lose 1 AC.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +3 to hit, 1d8+1 piercing. Antennae: Touch corrodes metal; if magical item, DC 11 Dex or object takes permanent -1 penalty.

name: Cockatrice
description: The cockatrice is a savage but senseless creature. Its bite can turn creatures to stone.

statBlock.actions: Bite: +3 to hit, 1d4+1 piercing + DC 11 Con save or restrained; fail again next turn or petrified for 24 hours.

name: Griffon
description: Griffons are fierce avian predators with the body of a lion and the head, wings, and forelegs of an eagle.

statBlock.traits: Keen Sight: Advantage on Perception using sight. Multiattack: 1 beak + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Beak: +6 to hit, 1d8+4 piercing. Claws: +6 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing.

name: Hell Hound
description: Hell hounds are vicious pack hunters that roam the Nine Hells and serve powerful devils.

statBlock.traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. Pack Tactics. Immunities: fire.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing + 2d6 fire. Fire Breath (recharge 5–6): 15-ft. cone, DC 12 Dex or 6d6 fire (half on save).

name: Gelatinous Cube
description: The gelatinous cube slowly moves through dungeon corridors, digesting anything that touches it.

statBlock.traits: Ooze Cube: Occupies full 10-ft. cube. Transparent: DC 15 Perception to notice. Immunities: cold; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone.
statBlock.actions: Pseudopod: +4 to hit, 3d6+2 acid. Engulf: DC 12 Dex or engulfed; restrained, blinded, 6d6 acid at start of each turn; DC 12 Str to escape.

name: Black Pudding
description: Black puddings are pools of mindless, oozing hungers that dissolve flesh and metal alike.

statBlock.traits: Amorphous. Corrosive Form: Metal or organic weapons take -1 penalty on hit; nonmagical weapon destroyed on 5 penalties. Spider Climb. Immunities: acid, cold, lightning, slashing; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone. Split: When lightning/slashing does damage, splits into two identical puddings.
statBlock.actions: Pseudopod: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 bludgeoning + 4d8 acid; wood or metal armor/weapons are damaged.

name: Air Elemental
description: An air elemental is a vortex of swirling winds that hisses across the world.

statBlock.traits: Air Form: Can move through spaces 1 inch wide without squeezing. Resistances: lightning, thunder; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious. Multiattack: 2 slams.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +8 to hit, 2d8+5 bludgeoning. Whirlwind (recharge 4–6): 10-ft. radius, 15-ft. cylinder; DC 13 Str or 3d8+5 bludgeoning and flung 20 ft. up.

name: Fire Elemental
description: A fire elemental is a flame brought to terrible life.

statBlock.traits: Fire Form: Can move through 1-inch spaces. Illumination: Sheds bright light 30 ft., dim 30 ft. more. Resistances: B/P/S from nonmagical. Immunities: fire, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious. Water Susceptibility: 1 cold per gallon of water. Multiattack: 2 touches.
statBlock.actions: Touch: +6 to hit, 2d6+3 fire. Ignites flammable objects. Ignite (1/turn): Flaming creature takes 1d10 fire.

name: Earth Elemental
description: An earth elemental rises from the earth itself, a rumbling column of stone and earth.

statBlock.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10
statBlock.traits: Earth Glide: Through nonmagical earth/stone without disturbing it. Siege Monster: Double damage to structures. Vulnerabilities: thunder. Resistances: nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: poison; exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious. Multiattack: 2 slams.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +8 to hit, 2d8+5 bludgeoning.

name: Water Elemental
description: A water elemental flows and surges over land and through water, drowning all in its path.

statBlock.traits: Freeze: If takes cold damage, speed reduced by 20 ft. until end of next turn. Water Form: Through 1-inch spaces. Resistances: acid; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious. Multiattack: 2 slams.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +7 to hit, 2d8+4 bludgeoning. Whelm (recharge 4–6): 10-ft. radius; DC 15 Str or grappled, restrained, and unable to breathe. Can hold up to 2 creatures.

name: Wolf
description: Wolves are pack predators that work together to bring down prey far larger than themselves.

statBlock.traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. Pack Tactics.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 piercing; DC 11 Str save or knocked prone.

name: Dire Wolf
description: Dire wolves are enormous predatory wolves found in wild regions.

statBlock.traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. Pack Tactics.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing; DC 13 Str save or knocked prone.

name: Brown Bear
description: Brown bears are powerful omnivores that defend their territory aggressively.

statBlock.traits: Keen Smell: Advantage on Perception using smell. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +6 to hit, 1d8+4 piercing. Claw: +6 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing.

name: Giant Spider
description: Giant spiders lurk in webs strung between tree trunks or in dungeon crannies.

statBlock.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
statBlock.traits: Spider Climb. Web Sense (tremorsense on webs). Web Walker.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing + 2d8 poison (DC 11 Con, half on save). Web (recharge 5–6): +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft.; restrained, DC 12 Str to escape.

name: Giant Rat
description: Giant rats swarm through sewers and ruins, spreading disease and gnawing at everything.

statBlock.traits: Keen Smell. Pack Tactics.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing.

name: Crocodile
description: Crocodiles are ferocious reptilian predators that lurk in rivers and swamps.

statBlock.traits: Hold Breath: 15 minutes.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d10+2 piercing; DC 12 Str or restrained (escape DC 12).

name: Giant Eagle
description: Giant eagles are noble predators that rule the open skies.

statBlock.languages: Giant Eagle, understands Common/Auran but can't speak
statBlock.traits: Keen Sight. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Beak: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 piercing. Talons: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 slashing.

name: Wyvern
description: Wyverns are lesser cousins of true dragons. They have powerful wings, a barbed tail, and deadly poison.

statBlock.traits: Multiattack: 1 bite + 1 stinger.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 piercing. Claws: +7 to hit, 2d8+4 slashing. Stinger: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 piercing + 7d6 poison (DC 15 Con, half on save).

name: Young Red Dragon
description: Red dragons are the most powerful and destructive of the chromatic dragons. Even young ones are devastating.

statBlock.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 18
statBlock.traits: Immunities: fire. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +10 to hit, 2d10+6 piercing + 1d6 fire. Claw: +10 to hit, 2d6+6 slashing. Fire Breath (recharge 5–6): 30-ft. cone, DC 17 Dex or 16d6 fire (half on save).

name: Adult Red Dragon
description: An adult red dragon is a catastrophic force of destruction. Its very breath can melt steel.

statBlock.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23
statBlock.traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day). Immunities: fire. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws or 3 Legendary Actions.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +14 to hit, 2d10+8 piercing + 4d6 fire. Claw: +14 to hit, 2d6+8 slashing. Tail: +14 to hit, 2d8+8 bludgeoning. Frightful Presence: 120-ft. radius, DC 19 Wis or frightened. Fire Breath (recharge 5–6): 60-ft. cone, DC 21 Dex or 26d6 fire.

name: Young Black Dragon
description: Cruel and capricious, black dragons delight in inflicting pain on their enemies with acid.

statBlock.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16
statBlock.traits: Amphibious. Immunities: acid. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 2d10+4 piercing + 2d4 acid. Claw: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing. Acid Breath (recharge 5–6): 30-ft. line, DC 14 Dex or 11d8 acid (half on save).

name: Young Green Dragon
description: The most cunning and duplicitous of the chromatic dragons, green dragons delight in corrupting others.

statBlock.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17
statBlock.traits: Amphibious. Immunities: poison. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 2d10+4 piercing + 2d6 poison. Claw: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing. Poison Breath (recharge 5–6): 30-ft. cone, DC 14 Con or 12d6 poison (half on save).

name: Hydra
description: A hydra is a reptilian horror with multiple heads that regrow when severed.

statBlock.traits: Hold Breath: 1 hour. Multiple Heads (5): Advantage on saves against knocked out/blinded/deafened. Reactive Heads: Extra reaction per head beyond one. Regeneration: Regrows 2 heads at start of turn if at 1+ HP; new heads stopped by fire/acid.
statBlock.actions: Multiattack: 1 bite per head (5 default). Bite: +8 to hit, 1d10+5 piercing.

name: Roper
description: A roper disguises itself as a rocky stalagmite while shooting sticky tendrils to reel in prey.

statBlock.traits: False Appearance: Resembles stalagmite. Grasping Tendrils (6): +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., restrained (DC 15 Str to escape). Reeling: Pull restrained target up to 25 ft. toward roper.
statBlock.actions: Multiattack: 4 tendrils + 1 bite. Tendril: +7 to hit, 2d6+4, restrained. Bite: +7 to hit, 4d8+4 piercing.

name: Doppelganger
description: A doppelganger can assume the form of any humanoid it has studied, replacing the original.

statBlock.traits: Shapechanger: Humanoid form only. Ambusher: Advantage on attacks in first combat round; +3d6 damage if surprised target. Surprise Attack: +3d6 on surprise hit. Immunities: charmed. Multiattack: 2 slams.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +6 to hit, 1d6+4 bludgeoning. Read Thoughts: DC 13 Wis or read surface thoughts within 60 ft.

name: Ettercap
description: Ettercaps are spider-like humanoids that dwell in forests, spinning webs to trap prey.

statBlock.traits: Spider Climb. Web Sense. Web Walker. Multiattack: 1 bite + 1 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d8+2 piercing + 1d8 poison (DC 11 Con or poisoned). Claws: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 slashing. Web (recharge 5–6): +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft.; restrained, DC 11 Str to escape.

name: Centaur
description: Centaurs are proud, warlike creatures that roam wild lands, attacking those who threaten their territory.

statBlock.traits: Charge: If moves 30 ft. toward target and hits with pike, +3d6 piercing. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Pike: +6 to hit, 1d10+4 piercing. Hooves: +6 to hit, 2d6+4 bludgeoning. Longbow: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.

name: Merrow
description: Merrow are merfolk who were corrupted by a demon lord and now serve Demogorgon as brutal hunters.

statBlock.traits: Amphibious. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +6 to hit, 1d8+4 piercing. Claws: +6 to hit, 2d4+4 slashing. Harpoon: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., 2d6+4 piercing; DC 14 Str or pulled 20 ft. toward merrow.

name: Lamia
description: Lamias are monstrous shapeshifters with lion-like lower bodies and humanoid upper bodies who curse their victims.

statBlock.traits: Spellcasting (Cha, save DC 13): At will: disguise self (any humanoid); 3/day: charm person, mirror image; 1/day: geas, major image, suggestion. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Claws: +5 to hit, 2d10+3 slashing. Dagger: +5 to hit, 1d4+3 piercing. Intoxicating Touch: touch, DC 13 Wis or under short-term madness for 1 hour; cannot benefit from short rests.

name: Guardian Naga
description: Guardian nagas are noble snakelike creatures that guard sacred sites with spells and fang.

statBlock.traits: Rejuvenation: Reforms 1d6 days after death. Spellcasting (Wis, save DC 16): at will: detect thoughts, sacred flame; 3/day: cure wounds, command, hold person; 1/day: flame strike, geas. Immunities: poison; charmed, poisoned. Multiattack: 1 bite + spells.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +8 to hit, 1d8+4 piercing + 4d10 poison (DC 15 Con, half on save). Spit Poison: +8 to hit, range 15/30 ft., 4d10 poison (DC 15 Con, half on save).

name: Dryad
description: Dryads are tree spirits who guard their forest domains with magic and deception.

statBlock.traits: Innate Spellcasting (Cha, save DC 14): at will: druidcraft, guidance; 3/day: entangle, goodberry, speak with animals, speak with plants; 1/day: barkskin, pass without trace, shillelagh. Magic Resistance. Speak with Beasts and Plants.
statBlock.actions: Club: +2 to hit (or +6 with shillelagh), 1d4 bludgeoning. Fey Charm: DC 14 Wis or charmed for 24 hours; one person and one beast at a time.

name: Satyr
description: Satyrs are merry wanderers of the Feywild. Their enchanting music lures travelers to revelry.

statBlock.traits: Magic Resistance.
statBlock.actions: Ram: +3 to hit, 2d4+1 bludgeoning. Shortsword: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 piercing. Shortbow: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.

name: Stone Golem
description: A stone golem is a massive humanoid carving animated by a spirit from the Elemental Plane of Earth.

statBlock.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
statBlock.traits: Immutable Form. Magic Resistance. Magic Weapons. Resistances: nonmagical, non-adamantine B/P/S. Immunities: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned. Multiattack: 2 slams.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +10 to hit, 3d8+6 bludgeoning. Slow (recharge 5–6): 10-ft. radius, DC 17 Wis or slowed for 1 minute (1 action/reaction per turn; attack rolls, Dex saves at disadvantage; -2 to AC).

name: Iron Golem
description: The mightiest of golems, an iron golem is an almost indestructible automaton.

statBlock.languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak
statBlock.traits: Fire Absorption: Heals from fire damage. Magic Resistance. Magic Weapons. Immunities: fire, poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned. Multiattack: 2 attacks.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +13 to hit, 3d8+7 bludgeoning. Sword: +13 to hit, 3d10+7 slashing. Poison Breath (recharge 6): 15-ft. cone, DC 19 Con or 10d8 poison, poisoned for 1 minute.

name: Animated Armor
description: Enchanted plate mail that stands up to fight without a wearer inside.

statBlock.traits: Antimagic Susceptibility: Incapacitated in antimagic field. False Appearance: Indistinguishable from normal armor when motionless. Immunities: poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned. Multiattack: 2 slams.
statBlock.actions: Slam: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 bludgeoning.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
description: Will-o'-wisps are malevolent spirits that haunt swamps and lure travelers to their doom.

statBlock.languages: the languages it knew in life
statBlock.traits: Consume Life: Feeds on dying creatures within 5 ft. Ephemeral: Can't wear/carry anything. Incorporeal Movement. Variable Illumination: Bright/dim light 5–20 ft. Resistances: acid, cold, fire, necrotic, thunder; nonmagical B/P/S. Immunities: lightning, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
statBlock.actions: Shock: +4 to hit, 2d8 lightning. Invisibility.

name: Aboleth
description: Aboleths are ancient, alien beings of tremendous psionic power who lurk in deep underwater lairs.

statBlock.traits: Amphibious. Mucous Cloud: Breathing air within 5 ft. must succeed DC 14 Con or diseased. Probing Telepathy: Reads thoughts of telepathied creatures. Legendary Actions (3). Multiattack: 3 tentacles.
statBlock.actions: Tentacle: +9 to hit, 2d6+5 bludgeoning; diseased on hit (DC 14 Con or max HP halved). Tail: +9 to hit, 3d6+5 bludgeoning. Enslave (3/day): DC 14 Wis save or charmed indefinitely. Psychic Drain (Legendary): 3d6 psychic, regains HP.

name: Behir
description: A behir is a lightning-breathing serpentine predator with twelve legs that claims a large territory.

statBlock.traits: Immunities: lightning. Multiattack: 1 bite + 1 constrict.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +10 to hit, 3d10+6 piercing. Constrict: +10 to hit, 2d10+6 bludgeoning; restrained, DC 16 Str to escape. Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6): 20-ft. line, DC 16 Dex or 12d10 lightning. Swallow: DC 16 Str or swallowed (blinded, restrained, 6d6 acid/turn; burst free at 30 damage).

name: Bulette
description: A bulette, or land shark, is an armored predator that burrows through earth to ambush prey.

statBlock.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 16
statBlock.traits: Standing Leap: 30 ft. long, 15 ft. high.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 4d12+4 piercing. Deadly Leap: Jumps and lands in adjacent space; DC 16 Str or Dex or 3d6+4 + knocked prone.

name: Chimera
description: The chimera is a monstrous amalgam of lion, goat, and dragon that breathes fire.

statBlock.traits: Multiattack: 1 bite + 1 horns + 1 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 piercing. Horns: +7 to hit, 2d10+4 bludgeoning. Claws: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing. Fire Breath (recharge 5–6): 15-ft. cone, DC 15 Dex or 7d8 fire (half on save).

name: Yuan-ti Pureblood
description: Yuan-ti purebloods are the least degenerate of the yuan-ti, appearing almost fully humanoid.

statBlock.traits: Innate Spellcasting (Cha, save DC 12): at will: animal friendship (snakes only), poison spray; 3/day: charm person, suggestion. Magic Resistance. Immunity: poison; poisoned.
statBlock.actions: Multiattack: 1 bite + 1 scimitar. Bite: +5 to hit, 1d4+3 piercing + 2d4 poison (DC 11 Con, half on save). Scimitar: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing. Shortbow: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 + 2d4 poison.

name: Troglodyte
description: Troglodytes are primitive humanoids that dwell in underground caverns. Their stench is nauseating.

statBlock.traits: Chameleon Skin: Advantage on Stealth checks. Stench: Creatures that start turn within 5 ft., DC 12 Con or poisoned until start of next turn. Sunlight Sensitivity. Multiattack: 1 bite + 2 claws.
statBlock.actions: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing. Claw: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 slashing.

name: Xorn
description: A xorn is a strange elemental creature that tunnels through earth seeking gems and metals to consume.

statBlock.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 16
statBlock.traits: Earth Glide. Stone Camouflage: Advantage on Stealth in rocky terrain. Treasure Sense: Can pinpoint precious metals/gems within 60 ft. Resistances: piercing and slashing from nonmagical B/P/S. Multiattack: 3 claws + 1 bite.
statBlock.actions: Claw: +6 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing. Bite: +6 to hit, 4d6+3 piercing.
